caption: Depth cues grouped into the three families used above. Retinal disparity and convergence need two eyes; the pictorial monocular cues (occlusion, relative size, perspective, shading, texture gradient) survive in a single photograph, but motion parallax does not, because a still print gives the eye no movement to work with.

spec.aria: A tree of depth cues split into binocular, monocular and oculomotor groups.
